title: Piranesi
creator: Susanna Clarke
summary: A man lives in a vast, impossible house filled with statues and tides. He keeps a journal. He doesn't know how he got there.
personalNote: Unlike anything else I've read. It starts as a puzzle and ends as something tender and strange. Clarke builds a world with such internal logic that by the time you understand what's happening, you've already accepted all of it completely. I finished it in one afternoon and sat with it for days.
favoriteQuote: The Beauty of the House is immeasurable; its Kindness infinite.
